title: Reaction Times and other Skewed Distributions: Problems with the Mean and the Median
engine: anomalyco/opencode (ReproAI) — DeepSeek V4 Flash via uniGPT
mode: reimplementation + live verification of author-committed reproducibility data
empiricism: Mixed methods / simulation paper. No original experimental data collected by the authors; Section 5 analyses a large third-party behavioural dataset (French Lexicon Project, Ferrand et al. 2010). Open data stamped N/A, Open materials Yes, Open analysis Yes. Real-data empirical claims independently verifiable from the shipped FLP trials.

data_sources.osf_main: 10.17605/OSF.IO/3UZAM — project contains cover-letter PDF + wiki images only
data_sources.figshare_package: 10.6084/m9.figshare.6911924 (Rousselet & Wilcox 2018a) — verified live: code.zip (18 Rmd), functions.zip, notebooks.zip, figures.zip, data.zip (includes sim_miller1988.RData, miller_exg_param.RData, sim_bias_size_participants.RData, sim_precision.RData, sim_gp_fp*.RData, french_lexicon_project_rt_data.RData)
data_sources.raw_data: FLP trial-level data verified (959 participants, 1,917,983 rows)

rng_seed_notes: Code uses set.seed() (4, 21, 44, 7, 666) in notebooks, but the exact R session/RNGkind that produced each printed number is not pinned. Cross-R-version sample.kind change (Rounding->Rejection in R 3.6.0) breaks byte reproduction of resampling illustrations; even the shipped sim_miller1988.RData does not exactly regenerate printed Table 2.
